title: Observed findings or unclassified Copilot answers need no FO decision
detail: Real adapter fixtures yield Codex exit 1/P1 and Copilot exit 0/High line comment; record check/question both 0. The legacy citation-only control also accepts an unresolved finding, so an old automatic P1 guarantee is not claimed.
fix: Require head/evidence-bound FO judgment for findings/answered, preserving workflow-owned P1 waiver authority.

title: Known Copilot refusal needs no unread/retry decision
detail: Real exit 5 is saved as not-run; question lacks unread statement and retry yet passes. Contract assigns both to FO question.
fix: Apply one shared record-reader disclosure check at check and question; do not restore copied refusal prose.

title: Quoted prod profile bypasses conditional-reviewer trigger
detail: Single/double quoted prod with a valid security report and pending second reviewer accepts not-triggered; legacy holds.
fix: Reuse existing reviewer_problems/FM_PROFILE instead of duplicate raw regex.

title: Missing valid merge-head token is accepted
detail: Empty/nonhex/overlong merge-head question: legacy question 1, record question 0. Different valid head still holds.
fix: Require a nonempty bounded head-token list before comparing prefixes.

title: Current reviewer configuration is not reread by record question
detail: Invalid configuration after a passing observation: legacy question 2, record question 0. Fixture parity difference; no real mid-ask config change claimed.
fix: Run the existing configuration reader at question and join the configured names to saved rows.

title: Automatic count and scope disclosures have no record-route equivalent
detail: Legacy emits Unchecked counts:1 and scope mark; record emits neither, with no equivalent fields. Existing ADRs and immutable-question design need an explicit disposition.
fix: FO/Captain decision on record fields or question-writing behavior; excluded from the unapplied reviewer proposal.
